input.text: Complaints that allege unfair treatment are escalated to regional manager.
sources: Complaints that allege unfair treatment are escalated to the regional manager the same day.

input.text: Complaints are resolved within 15 business days of receipt, or the customer is told when to expect a resolution.
sources: Resolve complaints within 15 business days of receipt, or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.

input.text: Collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.
sources: Collect two forms of identification from each signer before opening the account, or one form plus a verified bank reference when the branch manager approves.

input.text: Treat an account as a new account for the first 30 days after it opens.
sources: An account is treated as a new account for the first 30 days after it opens.
